description: Cross-language contract for the session lifecycle controller (US1, FR-001..FR-005). A create returns a session id and Active; successive get calls reflect the platform status transitions (Active -> Idle -> Resumed); an invalid idle timeout is rejected; operations on a deleted session raise SessionClosed. The neutral 'get_status_script' lists the raw status the control-plane fake returns for each successive get.

cases.description: Create returns a session id and Active; the state reflects Active -> Idle -> Resumed via get.
An idle timeout above the supported 5-60 minute range is rejected.
An idle timeout below the supported 5-60 minute range is rejected.
After a session is deleted, any further operation on it raises SessionClosed deterministically.
